## Goal
Before a relative confirms an import, the app should be able to show what is inside, in plain words, with nothing saved. `plan_lines` (`setup_config.py:282-306`) does this for a setup file but needs a `SetupConfig`; a bundle holds a profile document instead. Add `bundle_plan_lines(doc) -> list[str]` that takes a document accepted by `validate_bundle_doc` (WO-501) and returns the same style of lines: how many addresses, phones, emails and relatives, whether a birth year or age is present, which removal scope (everything, phone only, email only), and the fixed sentences that consent and the mailbox are never inside a bundle and must be set up on this computer. Counts only: no name, address, phone or email appears.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. Output for a fake profile with 2 addresses, 1 phone, 1 email, 2 relatives and a birth date matches a stored expected list of lines (the test holds the list).
2. Singular and plural are right for 0, 1 and 2 of everything ("1 address", "2 addresses", "no phone numbers").
3. A birth date shows as "birth year given", never the month or day; a missing one shows "no birth year".
4. The lines include one sentence that consent is not in the bundle and the person will be asked to give it, and one that the removal mailbox is set up separately.
5. No line contains any value from the document (fake sentinel values for every field must not appear).
6. Words follow docs/POSITIONING.md: no "guarantee", "erase", "100%", "nothing is sent". A reading-level check of each line (average sentence length 15 words or fewer) is in the test.
7. Calling it on a document that fails validation raises `SetupFileError` with the validation problems (reuse the class at `setup_config.py:136-141`).

**Limits (every Grok WO, CLAUDE-G-004):** offline only. No network, credentials, git or gh, installs, or running the real app against real sites or a real mailbox; never read anything outside the repo. Fake people only (Jane Q Testperson, Springfield IL). Tests pass on Windows too (`tmp_path`, `pathlib`). Check `tests/copilot/`, `tests/codex/`, `tests/grok/` and the in-house `tests/test_*.py` first; don't duplicate a guard.
